chunks: We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main roles of the Prophet mentioned in Surah Al-Fath?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Fath is often interpreted as establishing the Prophet’s (and by extension, the Imams’) role as a divine witness (Shahid) who testifies to the truth of revelation and guides the community. The triad of 'glad tidings' (Mubashshir) and 'warner' (Nathir) underscores the dual nature of prophetic mission, balancing mercy with accountability, a concept deeply linked to the concept of Imamate as the continuing authority of guidance. This verse is frequently cited to demonstrate the comprehensive spiritual and judicial authority vested in the Prophet and his progeny.
